commits.message: fix(daemon): a renderer that ends in the close before the close ended it is a warning (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.w8l)

fix(daemon): the closed phase holds the end its close awaits, and the close's beginning is named beginClose (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.w8l)

High review of #778: the boot ended at the close's start is carried on the
closed phase rather than in a variable beside it; the link's method no longer
shares the daemon's closing signal's name; the ping test answers the boot's
ping so only a ping sent in the close can judge the hang; the close test reads
the setting's value from the session file.

fix(daemon): once the close begins no renderer starts, and the renderer's own flush reports a turn that threw (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.w8l)

The teardown's first step tells the renderer link the close has begun: a live renderer stays to take the close's steps and is still pinged, a boot under way ends with the close grace, a down renderer's retry is cancelled, and an end in the close is logged and starts nothing. The session-state flush stays an ask the host judges.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.225.0
